entries.back_en: As you can see, I find myself imprisoned in this place. I would be most grateful if you could free me from here.
Who else could it be!? Of course I am! Now dispel those pillars and free me from this place!
If you wish to free me, go destroy those pillars that imprison me here.
entries.note: Erro gramatical: 'que me aprisionar aqui' deveria ser 'que me aprisionam'.

entries.back_en: At last! I thought I'd never escape from there!
First of all, I must thank you for the help. One problem still remains, however...
You see well, I do not have a body.
This means I cannot leave here.
That's why I wish you to find a medium who can lend me a body.
Don't worry--here they summon gods and the like! There must be many mediums around!
Remember, once back outside, you need to find a medium. Oh, and... Try to find a good-looking one, if you can, okay?
entries.note: Inconsistencia de voz: mistura 'vós' (Lembrai-vos) com 'vocês' (Tentem, conseguirem) e o coloquial 'ta bem'.
